title: Maury Island incident: slag rains onto a boat
summary: Peter Levenda tells of Maury Island incident: slag rains onto a boat, about 1947 at Washington, D.C., and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: guy sitting in a boat in Puet Sound and what appear to be UFOs of some kind are flying overhead and one of them appears to be in distress and it rains like shards of metal or slag or something all over his his boat,
